Martyred intellectual Dr Fazle Rabbee’s death anniversary today
2013-12-15T00:00:00+06:00 | City Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/martyred-intellectual-dr-fazle-rabbee-s-death-anniversary-today-2553

Today is the 42nd death anniversary of Shaheed Dr Fazle Rabbee. On this day in 1971, Pakistani occupation army and its collaborator Al-Badr force picked him up from his Siddheshwari residence in the capital in the afternoon and killed him brutally at Rayer Bazar at midnight, says a press release. His body was recovered from the Rayer Bazar killing field on December 18, two days after the victory of Bangladesh in the Liberation War. Rabbee, a renowned heart specialist, served Dhaka Medical College as a professor of medicine and cardiology. To mark his death anniversary, wreaths will be placed at his grave this morning and food will be distributed among the poor.
